runs.text: When several answers can arrive, you serve the first one and cut what is no longer needed.
The problem
The kiosk orders fruit from
three suppliers
at once: North, South and West. If
any of them has no stock
, the whole order is suspended and there is no point in waiting for the others.
How do you write the order so that the first problem stops everything, and how do you know how many queries were cut?
Try it
North has no stock; South has 5 and West has 3. What happens to the order?
The order is suspended because of North. The queries that had not finished yet are cut: with the turns the engine gives today, they are the other
two
Understand and plan

entries.text: What goes in and what comes out?
The stock of each supplier goes in; out comes whether the order is confirmed or why it was suspended.
The tray of lesson 5.1: three tasks in the same scope.
What can happen at once and what has to wait?
The three queries go at once; the first one that fails cuts the others.

runs.text: The new tool
Sometimes only the first answer matters.
waits on several channels at once and serves the first one that is ready; the others are left unserved.

runs.text: The two offers set off at once.
The North one arrives first and is served.
The South one is no longer needed: it is cut.

blocks.title: The first offer

runs.text: What is guaranteed is that, if any fails, the order is suspended and the report carries an error. Which error is
the first
when two fail, and how many queries get cut, depends on the turns: the exercises do not ask about it.
Improve

The three queries go at once, and the first error suspends the order and cuts the rest
Compare
with waiting for the answers one after another. If only one answer matters, waiting for all of them wastes the wait: with
, the first one ready is already served.
What you learned

points.text: Cancelling is cutting a task that is no longer needed; in a scope, the first error cancels the sisters.

runs.text: Practise

entries.text: The schedule decides it: do not assume it.
«Cancelling erases what the task already did».
What was already written stays; cancelling only cuts what was missing.
One task fails; the ones cut because of it did not fail.

runs.text: When the kiosk closes, everything the program knew is lost. How do you keep it for tomorrow?
